tools.name: payto_check
tools.description: Check whether an x402 endpoint or wallet pays out where it claims to, before your agent sends funds. Takes one wallet address or endpoint URL. Returns any catalog-vs-live payout mismatch, dated payout-rotation history, and whether the address has settled on chain. Free, no key. Use mismatch_feed ins

tools.name: mismatch_feed
tools.description: List x402 endpoints currently advertising one payout address while asking payers for another, from merona's nightly probe of the public catalog — the top 10 entries with advertised vs live addresses, full counts and as-of dates (complete feed, uncapped: merona.io/mismatches.json). Takes no arguments

tools.name: clean_stats
tools.description: Get wash-adjusted x402 settlement volume per chain — spend that survives removal of funded loops and self-dealing cycles, which can differ from raw transfer totals by orders of magnitude. Returns clean settlement count, clean volume in USD and an as-of date per chain. Takes no arguments. Free, no ke

tools.name: trust_score
tools.description: Score a specific seller wallet before paying it: wash-aware m.Score with an A–F grade, component breakdown, wash flags including multi-hop cycle detection, and the snapshot SHA so the result can be re-derived independently. Requires chain and address. Free — no key or payment needed. Optional: pass

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mismatch_feed" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
